label: Anatomical studies, Milan and Pavia

value.text: Heart studies c.1511 to 1513 based on ox hearts

claims.statement: RCT: after 1511 Leonardo had little or no access to human material and his heart dissections were of the ox. The bovine source is read from the drawings and notes.
